## Current role

**Software Engineer I, NAVIOM** — Gurugram, India. Jul 2026 to present.
Stack: TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, GCP, Docker.

- Owns the platform layer of a cross-border logistics product built from scratch,
  shipping four versioned internal packages — Workflow Engine, Rules Engine,
  Integration Adapter Framework, and Vault — consumed by 6 services.
- Designed and built the Workflow Engine end to end: a case management system turning
  operational exceptions into owned, SLA-tracked tickets via auto-assignment,
  maker-checker approvals, and evidence-gated closure.
- Built a unified partner Integration Adapter with retries, a cross-instance Redis
  sliding-window circuit breaker, and fail-closed routing. Shipped a versioned Rules
  Engine running at p95 under 150ms, covered by 75 unit and integration tests.
- Rolled out an AI-assisted delivery workflow using Claude Code with repo-level
  context, custom skills, and MCP-backed spec-to-test scaffolding and PR review,
  cutting spec-to-merge time 40% while keeping human review and CI gates.

## Previous role

**Software Engineer I, MAQ Software (client: LinkedIn)** — Noida, India.
Jan 2025 to Jun 2026, intern converted to full time.
Stack: Java, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Python, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Linux.

- Migrated LinkedIn's high-volume financial stream-processing pipeline from Samza to
  Apache Flink, cutting Kafka I/O memory 45% through object reuse and fewer
  intermediate allocations, and raising throughput 20% through parallel execution
  and operator chaining.
- Built the tooling that scaled the migration across repositories: automated code
  transformation, metric-gated progressive rollout, and checkpoint-aware rollback,
  cutting manual effort 70%.
- Built DAG-based model-lineage discovery and metadata collection for LinkedIn's
  MegaRefresh initiative, enabling reproducibility, tiering, and policy-gated
  publishing across 850+ models.

## Nxa

Nxa is a small product studio Aman Verma co-builds. It has shipped Nxacare and
Knowledgify, and takes on select client projects — web apps, internal tools, and
full-stack product MVPs.

## Selected projects

**Nxacare** — https://nxacare.com — multi-tenant SaaS clinic management platform
built with Nxa, spanning 10+ modules with a staff admin panel and a separate patient
app. Source: https://github.com/aman247av/nxacare-backend
Built the appointment-booking system with an availability engine reconciling doctor
schedules, slot capacity, and concurrent requests to prevent double-booking.
Architected the payment layer integrating Stripe and Razorpay behind a factory
pattern, with webhook signature verification and circuit-breaker gateway fallback.
Automated notification, invoicing, and appointment workflows with BullMQ queues, and
built subscription billing with tiered plans, usage quotas, and feature gating.
Multi-tenant isolation runs through 19+ data models so each clinic's data is scoped
rather than filtered. Modules include appointments, treatment plans, prescriptions,
billing and invoicing, subscriptions, and real-time patient chat.
Stack: Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Socket.IO, Docker.

**Knowledgify** — Android app for diploma students built with Nxa, 10,000+ installs
and 4.1 stars on Google Play. Stack: Java, Android SDK, Firebase.

**Currency Exchange** — Spring Boot microservices with an API gateway and Eureka
service discovery, deployable via Docker Compose. Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Docker.
